p: and they would give him … jugs … as payment. … came … told Abaye

and they would give him the jugs in which the wine had been stored as payment. The jugs that the wine had been stored in were included in the sale, and the gentiles would pay him by returning the jugs. People came and told Abaye

p: But doesn’t he desire the preservation of
that the wineskins should not be torn,
where he stipulated with … Alternatively, … where … brought barrels [perisdakei] with them,

where he stipulated with the gentile purchasers that even if the wineskins were to tear it would be at their expense and not his, and he would keep the jugs in any event. Alternatively, it is a case where the gentile purchasers brought barrels [perisdakei] with them,
g: או גם כן, מדובר היה שמביאים כדים ריקים של חרס איתם

p: But didn’t he ferry them over the crossing, … which is laboring with forbidden … as he … said to the ferryman initially … Alternatively,

But didn’t he ferry them over the crossing, which is laboring with forbidden wine? The Gemara answers: This is not a case where he was ferrying the wine over the crossing himself, as he made an arrangement with the ferrymen and said to the ferryman initially that the latter would ferry the buyers and the barrels without payment.
